answer: Argentina won the 2022 FIFA World Cup. In the final (match id 1), Argentina drew with France 3–3 after regulation/extra time and won the penalty shootout 4–2, per world_cup.world_cup.matches and world_cup.world_cup.teams (via world_cup.world_cup.tournaments filtered to year 2022, stage = "final").

toolCalls.name: run_readonly_sql
toolCalls.input:
{
  "sql": "SELECT t.id, t.year, m.id as match_id, m.stage, wt.name as winner_team, ht.name as home_team, at.name as away_team, m.home_score, m.away_score, m.penalty_home_score, m.penalty_away_score
FROM world_cup.world_cup.tournaments t
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.matches m ON m.tournament_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN world_cup.world_cup.teams wt ON wt.id = m.winner_team_id
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.teams ht ON ht.id = m.home_team_id
JOIN world_cup.world_cup.teams at ON at.id = m.away_team_id
WHERE t.year = 2022 AND m.stage ILIKE '%final%'
ORDER BY m.id",
  "rationale": "I'm locating the 2022 World Cup final match and its recorded winner to answer who won the tournament."
}
